environment: Python 3.14.7, node:test, glab and gh shims from the testkit on PATH, scratch git repos from cli-runner. No HTTP boundary.

cases.title: One glab call for 1, 3, 50 and hostile samples
cases.given: stub glab, forge gitlab, samples of 1, 3, 50 names and 7 hostile names
cases.then: one call, argv api projects/:fullpath/push_rule, cwd is the repo, no sample in argv
cases.expected: one call, argv api projects/:fullpath/push_rule, cwd is the repo, no sample in argv
cases.actual: 1 call each time; argv fixed; cwd equal to the repo; by_sample keyed by every sample

cases.title: Exit 0 with a JSON error body is no rule; exit 1, 2, 127, 255 are failures
cases.given: stub glab prints {message: 404 Project Not Found}
cases.then: exit 0: no rules, no notes, unchecked false. Non-zero: one note, unchecked true
cases.expected: exit 0: no rules, no notes, unchecked false. Non-zero: one note, unchecked true
cases.actual: as expected; note is rules unknown on gitlab: glab exited with status <code>
cases.specSource: R-030 acceptance, R-031 acceptance, ADR f2c2

cases.title: Exit 1 with stderr boom gives the exact spec note
cases.then: notes equal [rules unknown on gitlab: boom]; rules, by_sample empty; unchecked true
cases.expected: notes equal [rules unknown on gitlab: boom]; rules, by_sample empty; unchecked true

cases.title: Hostile stderr (empty, multi-line, CRLF, 2 MB, control, NUL, invalid UTF-8, token-like) gives one note and never raises
cases.given: stub glab exit 1 with each stderr
cases.then: one note starting rules unknown on gitlab:, unchecked true, valid shape
cases.expected: one note starting rules unknown on gitlab:, unchecked true, valid shape
cases.actual: all 8 held. See seeds for line, length and control character findings

cases.title: 29 odd stdout bodies keep the result shape
cases.given: stub glab exit 0 with array, string, number, true, false, null, non-string regex (number, list, object, true), spaces, invalid RE2, lookahead, NUL/ESC, lone surrogate, BOM, NaN, duplicate keys, extra keys, 100000-deep array and object, 20 MB body, 1 MB regex, huge int, empty, partial, trailing garbage, HTML
cases.then: no exception; any rule has exactly the five keys with right types; non-string regex gives no rule; unparseable output gives the note
cases.expected: no exception; any rule has exactly the five keys with right types; non-string regex gives no rule; unparseable output gives the note
cases.actual: all 29 held. A regex of only spaces, invalid RE2, NUL or lone surrogate gives one rule with a string pattern

cases.title: A valid regex round-trips as the exact pattern with the five keys
cases.then: rule equals {source gitlab, kind regex, pattern, negate false, label push rule}; by_sample holds it
cases.expected: rule equals {source gitlab, kind regex, pattern, negate false, label push rule}; by_sample holds it

cases.title: Missing glab gives the note and no side effect
cases.given: PATH holds only python3 and git
cases.then: one note, unchecked true, scratch tree and git refs unchanged
cases.expected: one note, unchecked true, scratch tree and git refs unchanged
cases.actual: note: rules unknown on gitlab: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'glab'; tree diff empty

cases.title: Empty, non-JSON and partial JSON output give the not JSON note
cases.given: stub glab exit 0 with each output
cases.then: note rules unknown on gitlab: glab printed output that is not JSON
cases.expected: note rules unknown on gitlab: glab printed output that is not JSON

cases.title: A stalled glab hits the timeout, gives the note, leaves no child
cases.given: stub glab does exec sleep 600; FORGE_TIMEOUT set to 1
cases.then: note, no hang, no process left, tree unchanged
cases.expected: note, no hang, no process left, tree unchanged
cases.actual: returned in 1037 ms; no process with the stub path left; tree unchanged

cases.title: Seed probe: a glab that forks a grandchild leaves a process after the timeout
cases.given: stub glab sleeps 25 s in a child of its shell; FORGE_TIMEOUT 1
cases.actual: note returned. The grandchild sleep stayed alive after the timeout. Out of scope, filed as a seed. The seed test fails by design

cases.title: No forge makes no call for absent, empty, null, unknown, wrong-case and padded forge values
cases.given: gh and glab stubs on PATH
cases.then: no call to either tool; no rules, no notes, empty by_sample, unchecked true
cases.expected: no call to either tool; no rules, no notes, empty by_sample, unchecked true

cases.title: Seed probe: a config that is not valid JSON
cases.given: gh and glab stubs on PATH, config.json holds {not json
cases.actual: no call made; read_rules raises Fail (the repo's config loader convention). Filed as a seed

cases.title: A token in the glab body or env never reaches the result, stderr or the tree
cases.given: body holds private_token, env holds GITLAB_TOKEN

cases.title: gh path: sample is percent-encoded in the path; FORGE_TIMEOUT applies to gh
cases.when: sample a/b c?x=1&y#z; stalled gh with timeout 1
cases.then: one encoded path; timeout gives a github note
cases.expected: one encoded path; timeout gives a github note

seeds.title: Failure note carries raw stderr: newlines, control characters, NUL and unbounded length
seeds.detail: glab stderr is copied into the note unchanged. A 2 MB stderr gives a 2 MB note. Multi-line stderr gives a note with newlines. ESC and NUL pass through. The spec states no bound, so no block. Tests in the verify file named VS-5 seed fail.

seeds.title: Timeout kills only the direct glab process
seeds.detail: subprocess.run kills the child on timeout, not its children. A glab wrapper that forks a process leaves that process alive after FORGE_TIMEOUT. Start the child in its own process group and kill the group.

seeds.title: read_rules raises Fail when .sdlc/config.json is not valid JSON
seeds.detail: The plan notes expect a no-forge result for a config that is not valid JSON. The code raises Fail. This matches the loader convention, so it may be intended. No call to gh or glab happens. Decide the intended behavior.

seeds.title: A regex of only spaces, or invalid RE2 syntax, becomes a rule
seeds.detail: gitlab_rule keeps any non-empty string. A spaces-only regex gives a rule that matches every name. R-030 says only an empty regex means no rule, so this follows the spec. Judge handles invalid syntax as unevaluated.

seeds.title: testkit: glab-stub cannot assert a process group or leftover child
seeds.detail: The shim runs sleep as a child of sh. The test used ps with the stub path or the sleep text. A helper that reports leftover children would help.
